regions.name: Southern, Central, and Northeastern
regions.where: All of Somalia except the far north-west: the south (Juba, Shabelle, Bay, Bakool, Gedo), central regions and the north-east including Sool, Sanaag, Bari and Nugaal (purple on the locator map)
regions.notes: Xagaa Showers are a lighter-blue band (Jul-Aug); the Dry Seasons row calls Jul-mid-Sep the Xagaa dry season. Exact edges: pastoral major lean Feb to mid-Apr; cropping major lean Apr to mid-Jun; pastoral minor lean mid-Aug to mid-Oct; cropping minor lean Oct to mid-Dec; S1 planting mid-Mar to end-Apr; S2 planting mid-Sep to end-Oct; off-season planting Jun to mid-Jul. The off-season harvests (Mar, Sep) are not tied to a rainy season on the image (riverine off-season). The planting row also has an S2 bar in January (flat left end) and an off-season bar in December (flat right end).

regions.name: Northwest Somalia: Northwestern Agropastoral and West Golis Pastoral
regions.where: The far north-west: Awdal, Woqooyi Galbeed and the Sheikh/Burao area of Togdheer (purple on the locator map)
regions.notes: Exact edges: Gu Rains Apr to mid-Jun; Karan Rains Jul to mid-Sep; NW Agropastoral lean mid-Feb to mid-Jun; S1 planting mid-Mar to mid-Apr; S2 planting mid-May to mid-Jul; S2 harvest mid-Oct to end-Nov. The two lean boxes belong to different livelihood zones in the same block (West Golis pastoral; NW agropastoral); their labels do not say 'pastoral' or 'cropping', so kind is general. West Golis lean set to pastoral on review (2026-10-28): the block title reads 'West Golis Pastoral'.

assign.method: The north-west locator map covers Awdal, Woqooyi Galbeed and northern Togdheer (Sheikh, part of Burco); every other region is purple on the southern/central/north-eastern map.

transcriber_notes: Edges measured on the full-resolution image (only 2154 px wide); many are at mid-month and were counted (at-least-half rule). Burco district straddles the edge of the north-west map and was left with Togdheer in south-central-northeast. The block-1 region mixes riverine, agropastoral and pastoral zones in one calendar, so livelihood is 'mixed'.
